steps.content: More blue lights were hung after that. After several battles, you finally reach the terminal—an abandoned, barely-refurbished building. It's a small, airtight space with no windows, so you can't see what's going on outside.
When you come up from the underground station, you see mountains of containers and supplies, as well as dozens of eyes staring at you from all directions.

steps.speaker: Blue-Haired Gladiator
steps.content: Ohh... So... that small, scrawny shorty... is our leader?
The one leading the pack sneers. She tries to step forward, but someone else stops her.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Don't make trouble! That's a very important person!
The crowd stares at you with anticipation, excitement, hesitation, and fear. Many of them are holding leaflets. You feel a bit suffocated from the atmosphere.
The black raven suddenly lands on your shoulder. It tilts its head, caws, then flies off to a railing.
No one around you is surprised. You realize the raven is showing you the way.

The raven waits on the empty level. Only when you ask the two Sinners to guard the stairs and leave you alone does it continue to fly onwards, leading you to an empty office. Once inside, the raven disappears.

The room is quite messy, with maps, newspapers, and photos sprawled everywhere. It reminds you of Julien's office—only there's no machinery. You wait for a while, but no one comes, so you look around.
On the desk, you see some familiar papers with someone's writing on it. The writing has been crossed out and revised several times.
You rip open the envelope Julien gave you and take out the letter inside.
Hope you arrived safely. Now, as promised, I will tell you everything you need to know.
